svg.aria-label: Sahoshi — the shell (every operator page) — low-fidelity wireframe
svg.title: Sahoshi — the shell (every operator page) — low-fidelity wireframe
svg.text: Low-fidelity wireframe at 1440 px wide: rail 76 px, top bar 60 px, gutter 24 px. Greyscale; colour only for meaning.
Search a place, road, event or vehicle mark
LiveBand (36 px): only while something is live — a movement, a pursuit, a decision with a deadline.
Screen (main): one job per screen, at most one primary button
Rail 76 px · top bar 60 px · gutter 24 px
the first focus stop; shown at the top left only on focus
Rail, in the order of the officer's jobs: Home · Map · Decide · Plan · Assistant · Advisories; Analyst separated at the bottom
(visible to every officer). The Sahoshi mark sits on top: the only yellow on the console.
Decide carries the only badge, in orange: the decisions waiting for a named officer (also spoken in words for screen
Title of the screen: one line, it truncates; the search and every control keep their pixels.
Search, the prominent element (Ctrl K, Cmd K or /): Kolkata places, roads, events and vehicle marks.
Report: hold to speak a field report in Bengali, English or Hindi. It reaches the board as "Field report · unverified" for an
Language: বাংলা · English · हिंदी, with the data status and the exercise-data switch in the same menu. Console numbers stay
in Latin digits in all three.
Alerts bell: the last 50 alerts, read state per browser; a soft chime for each new decision (emulated ones chime only while
the console runs on exercise data).
Officer pill: "Name the duty officer · Plates hidden" until someone is named; then "On duty: <name>" and plates show to
that name only. Every decision records the name.
Keys: G then H / M / D / P / A / V moves between screens; Esc closes, then clears. No single key approves, unmasks,
Honest labels: one small tag, never a banner
from a real live feed (e.g. the rain nowcast)
a computed estimate (tide, ponding, the twin)
a scenario (traffic until Kolkata is recorded)
a claim from the field, not yet confirmed
a vision model's reading of a still
Solid outline: live or observed. Dashed: anything else.
Orange: needs a named officer's decision
Red: danger, impassable water, a stolen vehicle
Blue: a link, or text an AI wrote
Kolkata-taxi yellow: the Sahoshi mark only
Data status: rain live · tide modelled ·
Exercise data in use (flask in the bar)
R. Sen is a sample name.
dashed: modelled, simulated, emulated or unverified (or shown only when needed)
Rail and top bar sit at the same pixels on every operator page. The public pages (citizen, driver, welcome) use their own light shell with no sign-in.
